### Gene-level copy number

```{r cna-genes-prep}
# Reads SECTION_DATA[["cna"]] (R/sections/cna.R). Included at the end of _ascat.qmd, after
# its tabset closes. A plain HTML table (not DT): it is short, and follows the panel chips
# through window.registerPanelListener (script at the end of this file).
cna = SECTION_DATA[["cna"]]
cna_genes = if (!is.null(cna)) cna$genes else NULL
# trimws(): formatC(format = "fg") pads to a common width
cna_fmt = function(x, digits = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", trimws(formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = digits)))
cna_src_label = c(wakhan = "Wakhan", ascat = "ASCAT", savana = "SAVANA",
                  `wakhan-genes` = "Wakhan gene file")
cna_label = function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(cna_src_label), cna_src_label[x], x)

# One row per gene locus; a gene in several panels lists them all
cna_rows = NULL
if (!is.null(cna_genes) && nrow(cna_genes) > 0) {
  if (!"span_from" %in% names(cna_genes)) cna_genes[, span_from := NA_character_]
  cna_rows = cna_genes[, .(panels = paste(unique(panel), collapse = ","),
                           role = { r = role[!is.na(role) & nzchar(role)]; if (length(r)) r[1] else NA_character_ },
                           span_from = span_from[1]),
                       by = .(gene, chrom, start, end, min_cn, max_cn, min_minor, n_segments,
                              call, partial, loh, source, expected)]
  cna_rows[, flagged := !is.na(call) & (call != "neutral" | loh)]
  chrom_rank = match(cna_rows$chrom, chromosomes_for_sex("male"))
  call_rank  = match(cna_rows$call, CNA_CALL_LEVELS)
  call_rank[is.na(call_rank)] = length(CNA_CALL_LEVELS) + 1L
  cna_rows = cna_rows[order(call_rank, !loh, chrom_rank, start)]
}
```

```{r cna-genes-notices}
cna_panels = if (length(all_panels) > 0) names(all_panels) else character(0)
cna_no_coords = if (!is.null(cna)) cna$panels_without_coords else character(0)
# --sex sets the expected chrX/chrY copy number; ASCAT infers sex independently (XX / XY)
ascat_sex = if (!is.null(cna) && !is.null(cna$ascat_metrics)) toupper(cna$ascat_metrics$sex) else NA_character_
render_male = tolower(as.character(params$sex)) %in% c("male", "xy", "m")
sex_mismatch = !is.na(ascat_sex) && ascat_sex %in% c("XX", "XY") && (ascat_sex == "XY") != render_male
htmltools::tagList(
  if (sex_mismatch)
    section_notice(paste0("ASCAT inferred sex ", ascat_sex, ", but the report was rendered with --sex ",
                          params$sex, ". chrX/chrY gene calls assume ",
                          if (render_male) "one copy" else "two copies", " and may be wrong."), warn = TRUE),
  if (is.null(cna) || is.na(cna$source))
    section_notice("No copy-number segments (Wakhan integer profile or ASCAT segments) were found for this sample, so gene-level copy number cannot be called."),
  if (length(cna_panels) == 0)
    section_notice("No gene panel is embedded in this report. Gene-level copy number is called for the genes of the embedded panels."),
  if (length(cna_no_coords) > 0)
    section_notice(paste0("Panel", if (length(cna_no_coords) > 1) "s" else "", " without gene coordinates: ",
                          paste(cna_no_coords, collapse = ", "),
                          ". Their genes take their span from another embedded gene list where one has it, ",
                          "otherwise from Wakhan's own per-gene file, whose coordinates are the segment's, not the gene's."))
)
```

```{r cna-genes-summary, eval=!is.null(cna)}
# Purity/ploidy of every source, the one used first; genome-level WGD / LOH
pbs = cna$purity_by_source
pp_txt = if (nrow(pbs) > 0) {
  pbs = pbs[order(!used)]
  # Fixed two decimals, as the overview's purity card prints them
  fix2 = function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = 2))
  paste0(cna_label(pbs$source), " ", fix2(pbs$purity), " / ", fix2(pbs$ploidy),
         ifelse(pbs$used, " (used)", ""), collapse = "; ")
} else "not available"
g = cna$genome
pct = function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) "NA" else paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 1), "%")
genome_txt = if (!is.na(cna$source)) paste0(
  "WGD: ", if (isTRUE(g$wgd)) "yes" else if (isFALSE(g$wgd)) "no" else "NA",
  " (major allele ≥ 2 over ", pct(g$major2_fraction), " of the autosomes, ", cna_label(g$wgd_source), ")",
  " · LOH: ", pct(g$loh_fraction), " of the autosomes",
  if (!is.null(g$ascat_wgd) && !is.na(g$ascat_wgd))
    paste0(" · ASCAT's own: WGD ", if (g$ascat_wgd >= 1) "yes" else "no",
           ", LOH ", pct(g$ascat_loh), ", GI ", pct(g$ascat_gi)) else ""
) else NULL
tags$div(class = "cna-summary",
  tags$p(tags$strong("Purity / ploidy: "), pp_txt),
  if (!is.null(genome_txt)) tags$p(tags$strong("Genome: "), genome_txt)
)
```

```{r cna-genes-table, eval=!is.null(cna_rows) && nrow(cna_rows) > 0}
cell_cn = function(lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(lo), "–", ifelse(lo == hi, cna_fmt(lo), paste0(cna_fmt(lo), "–", cna_fmt(hi))))
locus = paste0(cna_rows$chrom, ":", formatC(cna_rows$start, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
               "–", formatC(cna_rows$end, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
call_slug = gsub("[^a-z]+", "-", ifelse(is.na(cna_rows$call), "none", cna_rows$call))

trs = lapply(seq_len(nrow(cna_rows)), function(i) {
  r = cna_rows[i]
  tags$tr(
    `data-gene` = toupper(r$gene), `data-panels` = r$panels,
    `data-flagged` = if (r$flagged) "1" else "0",
    tags$td(class = "cna-genes__gene", r$gene),
    tags$td(gsub(",", ", ", r$panels, fixed = TRUE)),
    tags$td(class = "cna-genes__locus", locus[i],
            if (!is.na(r$span_from)) tags$span(class = "cna-genes__span-from",
              if (r$span_from == "Wakhan segment") "Wakhan segment, not the gene's span"
              else paste0("span from ", r$span_from))),
    tags$td(class = "cna-genes__num", cell_cn(r$min_cn, r$max_cn)),
    tags$td(class = "cna-genes__num", if (is.na(r$min_minor)) "–" else cna_fmt(r$min_minor)),
    tags$td(tags$span(class = paste0("cna-call cna-call--", call_slug[i]),
                      title = paste0("expected CN ", cna_fmt(r$expected)),
                      if (is.na(r$call)) "no segment" else r$call),
            if (isTRUE(r$partial)) tags$span(class = "cna-genes__partial", "partial")),
    tags$td(if (isTRUE(r$loh)) tags$span(class = "cna-loh", "LOH") else ""),
    tags$td(if (is.na(r$role)) "" else r$role),
    tags$td(class = "cna-genes__source", cna_label(r$source))
  )
})

n_flagged = sum(cna_rows$flagged)
tags$div(id = "cna-genes", class = "cna-genes",
  tags$div(class = "cna-genes__bar",
    tags$label(class = "cna-genes__toggle-label",
      tags$input(type = "checkbox", class = "cna-genes__toggle"),
      paste0(" Show all panel genes (", formatC(nrow(cna_rows), big.mark = ","), ")")),
    tags$span(class = "cna-genes__count")
  ),
  tags$div(class = "cna-genes__scroll",
    # Opt out of Quarto's table post-processing (Bootstrap classes, odd/even striping that
    # would not follow the rows the filter hides)
    tags$table(class = "cna-genes__table", `data-quarto-disable-processing` = "true",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(c("Gene", "Panel", "Locus", "Total CN", "Minor CN", "Call",
                                  "LOH", "Role", "Source"), tags$th))),
      tags$tbody(trs)
    )
  ),
  tags$p(class = "cna-genes__empty section-notice", hidden = NA,
         if (n_flagged == 0) "No panel gene has a copy-number change or LOH. Tick “Show all panel genes” to list them all."
         else "No gene of the selected panel(s) has a copy-number change or LOH. Tick “Show all panel genes” to list them all.")
)
```

```{r cna-genes-details, eval=!is.null(cna) && !is.na(cna$source)}
pl = cna$ploidy
low = !is.na(pl) && pl <= CNA_PLOIDY_SPLIT
thr = if (is.na(pl)) "no ploidy is available, so no calls were made." else if (low)
  paste0("ploidy ≤ ", CNA_PLOIDY_SPLIT, ", so amplification = total CN ≥ ", CNA_AMP_CN_LOW,
         " and homozygous deletion = total CN 0.") else
  paste0("ploidy > ", CNA_PLOIDY_SPLIT, ", so amplification = total CN ≥ ", CNA_AMP_CN_HIGH,
         " and deep deletion = total CN < ploidy − ", CNA_LOSS_OFFSET, " = ",
         cna_fmt(pl - CNA_LOSS_OFFSET), " (homozygous deletion when the total CN is 0).")
male = tolower(as.character(params$sex)) %in% c("male", "xy", "m")
seg_txt = if (identical(cna$source, "wakhan"))
  paste0("Wakhan rank-1 integer_profile.bed (", formatC(nrow(cna$segments), big.mark = ","), " haplotype-resolved segments)") else
  paste0("ASCAT segments_raw.txt (", formatC(nrow(cna$segments), big.mark = ","), " allele-specific segments; Wakhan profile not found)")
n_wg = nrow(cna$wakhan_genes)
table_details(
  tags$p("Calls follow the COSMIC Cancer Gene Census CNA definition and are made on the total copy number ",
         "of the segments overlapping each gene's span (", seg_txt, "). This sample: ploidy ",
         cna_fmt(pl), " (", cna_label(cna$source), if (isTRUE(cna$ploidy_estimated)) ", estimated as the length-weighted mean CN — no solutions table" else "",
         "), ", thr, " Otherwise gain or loss against the expected CN, round(ploidy) = ",
         if (is.na(pl)) "NA" else round(pl),
         if (male) paste0(" (chrX/chrY: ", if (is.na(pl)) "NA" else max(1, round(pl / 2)), ")") else "", "."),
  tags$p("A gene spanning several segments is called amplified on its highest segment and homozygously ",
         "deleted on its lowest; “partial” marks a gene whose segments disagree, and Total CN then shows the range. ",
         "LOH = no minor allele on a non-zero segment where two alleles are expected. ",
         "Neutral genes are hidden unless “Show all panel genes” is ticked; the table follows the panel selection above."),
  tags$p("Purity / ploidy by source: ", pp_txt,
         ". Wakhan's is the cell purity of its rank-1 solution; the calls use the ploidy of the segment source."),
  if (n_wg > 0 || cna$wakhan_genes_dropped > 0)
    tags$p("Wakhan's per-gene file (genes_copynumber_states.bed, ", n_wg, " rows kept) is used only for panel genes without coordinates (source “Wakhan gene file”); ",
           cna$wakhan_genes_dropped, " of its rows were dropped as implausible (haplotype state > ", CNA_MAX_PLAUSIBLE_CN, ")."),
  summary = "Calls, thresholds and sources"
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Gene-level CN table: neutral rows hidden unless "Show all panel genes" is ticked; rows
// follow the panel chips via window.registerPanelListener (panel-js-data chunk). A row shows
// when no filter is active, or its data-panels intersect the active panels, or its gene is
// among the custom symbols. Idempotent: listeners fire more than once per change.
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById("cna-genes");
  if (!root) return;
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("tbody tr[data-gene]"));
  var toggle = root.querySelector(".cna-genes__toggle");
  var count = root.querySelector(".cna-genes__count");
  var empty = root.querySelector(".cna-genes__empty");
  var state = { panels: [], customGenes: [], all: true };
  function apply() {
    var showAll = !!(toggle && toggle.checked);
    var custom = new Set(state.customGenes || []);
    var n = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (tr) {
      var ok = showAll || tr.getAttribute("data-flagged") === "1";
      if (ok && !state.all) {
        var ps = (tr.getAttribute("data-panels") || "").split(",");
        ok = ps.some(function (p) { return state.panels.indexOf(p) >= 0; }) ||
             custom.has(tr.getAttribute("data-gene"));
      }
      tr.hidden = !ok;
      if (ok) n++;
    });
    if (count) count.textContent = n + " of " + rows.length + " shown";
    if (empty) empty.hidden = n > 0;
  }
  if (toggle) toggle.addEventListener("change", apply);
  if (typeof window.registerPanelListener === "function")
    window.registerPanelListener(function (s) { state = s || state; apply(); });
  apply();
})();
</script>
```
